mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 325 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 325).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a 'soft landing' scenario where the economy avoids recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%) fails to predict positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 5d SPX returns is negative or insignificant (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102) signals robust manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.
